report_title: Final commitment: exact Boolean auxiliary elimination
reformulation: input/model.mps 4,500 binary vars / 7,029 rows (1,971 E singletons, 2,029 four-term indicator pairs = 4,058 rows, 500 nine-term OR pairs = 1,000 rows; senses G 2,529 / L 2,529 / E 1,971 / N 1) / 27,203 nonzeros, objective min x1 -> output/reformulated.mps 500 vars / 2,539 G rows q1-q2539 (one forbidden-cube clause each) / 7,804 nonzeros, NAME test62r; all 4,000 auxiliaries and all 7,029 original rows removed; solver outcome Time limit reached/inf unchanged, so this is a certificate-only reformulation.
claim_class: Exact Boolean auxiliary elimination certified as an integer feasible-set projection equivalence on the 500 retained coordinates (with unique reconstruction of all 4,000 eliminated auxiliaries) plus, since V10, a caller-bound point-image exclusion: a full fractional source-LP witness is excluded from the target, with no LP-containment claim.
claim_coverage_gap: V7 request.json's only point claim was {"Feasible":{"target":false,"integers":false,"objective":null}}; the V7 receipt records ancillary_point_contract.certified=false, gap: 'Strictness and FiberStrictness require a separately established LP inclusion claim; Feasible only checks source feasibility and cannot assert exclusion from the target.' audit/DELIVERY_ACCEPTANCE.md:30 (P2) and audit/DELIVERY_LEDGER_REVIEW.md:9-15 flag test62 as incomplete for the original report scope (DELIVERY_ACCEPTANCE.md:9-11 gives corrected full-contract status 76/81, unfinished 36,46,58,62,83). request.json carries no field for the caller's declared property list, only claim kinds, so the gap was invisible to the kernel: verify reports counts (claims/bijections/points 2/1/1) and nothing about unbound properties. V10 repaired the property by a caller-bound ImageExclusion point claim; the detection half (refusing or flagging a reported property with no obligation) still has no API.
claims: 2 claims + 1 bijection + 1 point (cases/test62/preparation.json counts: claims 2, bijections 1, points 1, injectivity_coordinates 4500). Claim 0 forward (reverse:false, input/output integers, objective Equal) carries projection = 500 pairs (source retained index -> target index); claim 1 reverse carries the mirrored 500 pairs; both have inverse:null.

Block 0 (33,878,253 B; 2,539 root steps) proves the 2,539 target rows one Cases tree per row over the group's 3 or 4 relation variables: 38,013 Cases nodes covering the 7,968 local binary assignments, each leaf either a Lin witness or an Absurd built from the group's original OR rows by reduced(); checks = 1,500 domain observations + 2,539 row discharges + 501 Exact.

Block 1 (29,201,305 B; 6,087 root steps) proves the 7,029 source rows from the target: 2,029 interval groups on the extended model, then an 11,145-step body ending in Return{map = 4,500 source-coordinate expressions (500 identity, 1,971 constant 0, 2,529 generated indicators), checks = 7,029 rows + 1,001 Exact}.

Bijection (28,466,192 B; V7 form): request.json binds it only as {forward_claim:0, reverse_claim:1}; the proof carries 4,500 injectivity checks on a hand-built paired model (9,000 vars; 14,558 generated rows; 2,029 generated variables) asserting each source coordinate equals its reconstruction on both copies.

Point: request.json points[0] = {"ImageExclusion":{"point_in_target":false,"map":[500 affine expressions]}} and the 4,500 rational values exist only in proof.rpa (point block 42,884 B); the map is exactly the existing forward map, and the seven violated rows are supplementary preparer arithmetic the kernel does not count.

Six negative checks (cases/test62/preparation.json negative_checks) assemble and verify INVALID against the unmodified request, including point-specific attacks: infeasible_source_point -> 'INVALID point: image exclusion witness is not LP feasible (witness 0)' and wrong_exclusion_map -> 'INVALID requested point contract mismatch'.
agent_manual_work: Two independently written MPS parsers (whitespace records + Fraction; anchored regex + Decimal) agreeing on all 7,029 rows, 27,203 coefficients, the single RHS/bound set and 4,500 integer markers; established that 0.333 is exactly 333/1000 and that no coefficient record is duplicated (report section 2).

Coefficient-derived partition into 500 groups: 1,971 singleton fixings to zero, 2,029 four-term indicator pairs and 500 nine-term OR pairs, with incidence-closure checks that every row and every auxiliary occurrence is accounted for (no hidden incidences).

Exhaustive local semantics by hand: 64,000 primitive + 8,000 OR binary evaluations, then all-prime-implicate enumeration giving 2,539 clauses (1,635 width 3, 549 width 4, 348 width 2, 7 unit) and 7,804 literal-removal witnesses after cross-group dedup.

Graph analysis of the derived dependency graph: one undirected component of 500, directed SCC of 475 plus 25 singletons, and four self-input groups (x134, x249, x369, x498) which the replacement must preserve.

Exact fractional witness constructed and checked: retained coordinates 1/2, each active auxiliary 1/(2k) for k active patterns, fixed auxiliaries 0; satisfies all 7,029 original rows and 4,500 bounds and violates exactly 7 target rows; the run's single failed call was Decimal x Fraction multiplication while evaluating it (report section 7).
preparer_helpers: tools/prepare_test62.py (174 lines): defs cases (19-31), under (32-35), reduced (38-40), source_indicator (43-53), generated_indicator (55-61), prepare (64-164), main (167); imports parse_mps,row_ref from prepare_affine; expression,plus,mul,expr_json,row_fact from prepare_test40; SparseBuilder from prepare_test70; fix_binary from prepare_test88; extend from prepare_test23; substitute from prepare_test57; box from prepare_test54; rounded from prepare_test84; make_paired_model from menu_injectivity; execute from prepare_test8 (lines 7-16).

cases (19-31) hand-recurses binary Cases over the scope variables and asserts each leaf's end (Witness kind/expression, or Absurd positivity) before emitting {'Cases':{id,kind,expression,split,integer:{'VarInt':var},left,right}}.

source_indicator (43-53) rebuilds a source indicator from row facts via Lin plus EqPair on VarUpper with rounded() when the pattern does not match, or EqPair on VarLower from RowLower when it does; generated_indicator (55-61) repeats this over the extended model with RowUpper/RowLower index arithmetic.

prepare (64-164) consumes the agent's audit.json groups as the edit spec and re-asserts every record against real coefficients (assert refs['G']==plus(expression(1,{i:-1}),T,-1); assert len(set(allrows))==7029 and set(groupbyrow)==set(b['row_index'])).

The harness is prepare_test8.execute (91-114): writes 'RPA 10' + compact JSON, derives request.json from cert claims/points/bijections, then runs 19 rpx subprocesses (2 canonical, 3 assemble, 9 verify incl. 6 mutants, 2 repeat verifies) and records the receipt.
friction: No public proof-construction API: the whole 30,570-obligation certificate is dict literals emitted by local helpers, so the preparer restates every rule schema ('Cases', 'Return', 'IntervalLift', 'EqPair', 'Round') and every ref value by hand (tools/prepare_test62.py:19-61, 141-161).

The edit spec is the agent's untrusted 2.7 MB audit.json (schema exact-boolean-elimination-audit-v1): row names are rebound by hand to row indices and every record re-asserted inline (tools/prepare_test62.py:69-79, 128-135); any disagreement surfaces only as a failed kernel run.

Coordinate binding is positional convention: the reverse Return map lists 4,500 source-coordinate expressions in index order and the bijection checks equal[i] for i in range(4500), while request.json declares only 500 projection pairs and {forward_claim:0, reverse_claim:1}; nothing in the request pins the reconstruction order.

The V7 contract gap was invisible to the kernel: verify's payload reports only counts, so a request whose only point claim was Feasible{target:false,...} passed VERIFIED while the report's exclusion property stayed uncertified (audit/DELIVERY_LEDGER_REVIEW.md:13; V7 receipt ancillary_point_contract.certified=false).

Exact-rational interface friction: 47,016 Round steps convert the 333/1000 and 1/8 coefficient rows to integer rows, and the run's one failed call was Decimal x Fraction multiplication in the agent's independent witness evaluation (report section 7 / digest failing tool result).
